mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active as FEDFUNDS is continuously monitored.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE >= 10.0%) signals a weak labor market, prompting central bank easing and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE >= 10.0%

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE >= 10.0%) and labor market growth (PAYEMS growth < 0%) are both high, it signals a distressed labor market that triggers central bank easing, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE >= 10.0% AND PAYEMS growth < 0%

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL growth > 3% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL growth > 3% year-over-year

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing demand (HOUST < 500 thousand units) signals a slowing economy, prompting central bank easing and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 500

mechanism_narrative: Weak industrial production (INDPRO < 100 index) signals a slowing economy, prompting central bank easing and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and unemployment is high (UNRATE >= 10.0%), it signals strong monetary stimulus, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND UNRATE >= 10.0%

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL growth > 3% year-over-year) signals the Federal Reserve will tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL growth > 3% year-over-year
